# Step reference
{: .no_toc }

<!-- Generated by `bundle exec rake docs:steps`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every step the tool runs. **Core** steps are asked before `rails new` runs; **add-on** steps run afterwards, ordered by their dependencies (`needs`). Use `opinionated_rails list` and `opinionated_rails info STEP_ID` to see the same information in your terminal.

| Step | Tier | Needs | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`app_name`](#app_name) | core | none | Set the application name |
| [`app_type`](#app_type) | core | none | Choose API-only or full-stack |
| [`database`](#database) | core | none | Choose the database |
| [`frontend`](#frontend) | core | none | Choose the frontend stack |
| [`testing`](#testing) | core | none | Choose the test framework |
| [`auth`](#auth) | addon | none | Configure authentication |
| [`ci`](#ci) | addon | `rubocop`, `testing` | Configure CI |
| [`docker_kamal`](#docker_kamal) | addon | `database`, `frontend`, `solid_stack` | Configure Docker and Kamal |
| [`docs`](#docs) | addon | none | Generate project documentation |
| [`factory_or_fixtures`](#factory_or_fixtures) | addon | `testing` | Configure factories or fixtures |
| [`faker`](#faker) | addon | none | Add Faker |
| [`js_lint`](#js_lint) | addon | `frontend` | Configure JavaScript linting |
| [`mailer`](#mailer) | addon | `secrets_handling` | Configure mailers |
| [`pagination`](#pagination) | addon | none | Configure pagination |
| [`pr_issue_templates`](#pr_issue_templates) | addon | none | Generate GitHub templates |
| [`rubocop`](#rubocop) | addon | none | Configure RuboCop |
| [`secrets_handling`](#secrets_handling) | addon | none | Configure secrets handling |
| [`services`](#services) | addon | none | Add an application service architecture |
| [`solid_stack`](#solid_stack) | addon | none | Configure Solid Trifecta |
| [`spa_controller`](#spa_controller) | addon | `frontend` | Add a SPA catch-all controller |
| [`staging_env`](#staging_env) | addon | `solid_stack`, `mailer`, `docker_kamal` | Add staging environment |
| [`tailwind`](#tailwind) | addon | `frontend` | Configure Tailwind CSS |
| [`vcr`](#vcr) | addon | `testing` | Configure VCR |

## `app_name`
{: .no_toc }

Records the Rails application name used for the generated app.

- **Tier:** core
- **Needs:** none
- **Prompt:** App name (free text, valid Ruby constant once camelized, no leading digit)

## `app_type`
{: .no_toc }

Decides whether the app is API-only or a full-stack Rails app.

- **Tier:** core
- **Needs:** none
- **Prompt:** App type: API-only or Full-stack (default: Full-stack)

## `database`
{: .no_toc }

Prompts for the database adapter (SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL).

- **Tier:** core
- **Needs:** none
- **Prompt:** Database adapter: SQLite, PostgreSQL, or MySQL (default: SQLite)

## `frontend`
{: .no_toc }

Prompts for Stimulus+Hotwire, React, or no frontend for API-only apps.

- **Tier:** core
- **Needs:** none
- **Prompt:** Frontend: Stimulus+Hotwire (1) or React (2), default Stimulus; React also asks for a bundler

## `testing`
{: .no_toc }

Prompts for RSpec or Minitest as the test framework.

- **Tier:** core
- **Needs:** none
- **Prompt:** Test framework: RSpec or Minitest (default: Minitest)

## `auth`
{: .no_toc }

Prompts for a user model name and chooses Rails 8 built-in, Devise, or none.

- **Tier:** addon
- **Needs:** none
- **Prompt:** User model name (default: User), then Rails 8 built-in / Devise / None (default: None)

## `ci`
{: .no_toc }

Generates a GitHub Actions workflow for tests, RuboCop, security scans and JS lint.

- **Tier:** addon
- **Needs:** `rubocop`, `testing`
- **Prompt:** Enable CI workflow? (default: yes)

## `docker_kamal`
{: .no_toc }

Generates a Dockerfile and optional Kamal deployment files.

- **Tier:** addon
- **Needs:** `database`, `frontend`, `solid_stack`
- **Prompt:** Enable Kamal deployment? (default: no) — Docker itself is always generated

## `docs`
{: .no_toc }

Creates AGENT.md and STYLE.md files.

- **Tier:** addon
- **Needs:** none
- **Prompt:** none (always runs)

## `factory_or_fixtures`
{: .no_toc }

Adds FactoryBot for RSpec or keeps Minitest fixtures.

- **Tier:** addon
- **Needs:** `testing`
- **Prompt:** FactoryBot or Fixtures for RSpec (default: FactoryBot)

## `faker`
{: .no_toc }

Adds the Faker gem for generating fake data.

- **Tier:** addon
- **Needs:** none
- **Prompt:** none (always runs)

## `js_lint`
{: .no_toc }

Installs ESLint and writes an ESLint 9 flat config (eslint.config.js) for the chosen frontend stack.

- **Tier:** addon
- **Needs:** `frontend`
- **Prompt:** Enable JS linting? (default: yes)

## `mailer`
{: .no_toc }

Sets up Letter Opener in development and Postmark in production.

- **Tier:** addon
- **Needs:** `secrets_handling`
- **Prompt:** Enable mailer setup (Letter Opener dev / Postmark production)? (default: yes)

## `pagination`
{: .no_toc }

Installs geared_pagination or pagy for paginated collections.

- **Tier:** addon
- **Needs:** none
- **Prompt:** Pagination: geared_pagination or pagy (default: pagy)

## `pr_issue_templates`
{: .no_toc }

Adds default pull request and issue templates.

- **Tier:** addon
- **Needs:** none
- **Prompt:** none (always runs)

## `rubocop`
{: .no_toc }

Installs and configures RuboCop with Omakase defaults or a custom setup.

- **Tier:** addon
- **Needs:** none
- **Prompt:** RuboCop style: Omakase or Custom (default: Omakase)

## `secrets_handling`
{: .no_toc }

Chooses Rails encrypted credentials or dotenv for managing secrets.

- **Tier:** addon
- **Needs:** none
- **Prompt:** Secrets handling: Rails credentials or dotenv (default: Rails credentials)

## `services`
{: .no_toc }

Installs an ApplicationService base class and an in-house Result object.

- **Tier:** addon
- **Needs:** none
- **Prompt:** Add an application service architecture? (default: no)

## `solid_stack`
{: .no_toc }

Sets up Solid Queue, Solid Cache, and Solid Cable for background jobs, caching, and Action Cable.

- **Tier:** addon
- **Needs:** none
- **Prompt:** Background jobs/cache/cable: Solid Trifecta or Redis+Sidekiq (default: Solid)

## `spa_controller`
{: .no_toc }

Generates the always-present spa_controller.rb#root action.

- **Tier:** addon
- **Needs:** `frontend`
- **Prompt:** none (always runs)

## `staging_env`
{: .no_toc }

Creates a staging Rails environment file and configuration.

- **Tier:** addon
- **Needs:** `solid_stack`, `mailer`, `docker_kamal`
- **Prompt:** Add a staging environment? (default: no)

## `tailwind`
{: .no_toc }

Installs Tailwind v3 with a path appropriate for the chosen frontend.

- **Tier:** addon
- **Needs:** `frontend`
- **Prompt:** none (always runs)

## `vcr`
{: .no_toc }

Installs VCR for recording and replaying HTTP interactions in tests.

- **Tier:** addon
- **Needs:** `testing`
- **Prompt:** Enable VCR for HTTP interaction recording? (default: no)
